role.name: Self test - DVA token
role.description: Not a conformance test. Checks that the token asserts of the Auth DVA set fire: that they pass on a conforming envelope, that they react to one that is only signed, and that a request without a token is caught. Run it with Automated on: the engine then sends the requests itself and no caller is needed. All three scenarios have to end green, the last two on the judgement that the expected warnings appeared.
